توجيه ترتيب اللوحة: {{layout}}.

Do not add explanatory copy, other logos, a separate color palette, identity applications, or product imagery. Avoid misspellings, extra characters, distortion or overlap, excessive ornament, clutter, unrelated elements, dramatic shadows, and 3D effects. Do not imply a complete identity or claim that the design is original or approved.

Keep visual attention on the cup’s form, with crisp detail, smooth tonal transitions, and realistic professional product photography. Do not add hands, props, ingredients, unspecified product features, logos, text, watermarks, or interfaces. One still image only.
